name: Reference Depth Park
reference: User-approved Pickleball Park LeafGreen Pixel Concept composition

originalGeneratedFoliage.method: Built-in image_gen tool, transparent RGBA; no API fallback, third-party game assets or paid asset packs
originalGeneratedFoliage.prompt: ONE original lush park tree sprite, transparent background; orthographic 45-degree-above three-quarter view; broad rounded layered scalloped crown, interlocking leaf bough clusters, dark teal ink shadow edges, forest and emerald midtones, chartreuse lime highlights upper-left, substantial short warm brown trunk; fine purposeful stepped pixel clusters; no gradients, blur, smooth vector circles, cone silhouette, clay style, ground, detached shadow, text or multiple trees.
originalGeneratedFoliage.editing: No image editing or background conversion; generated alpha preserved

textureSources: Deterministic editable RGBA DataTexture constructions in depth-park-environment.js: grass, sand, terracotta roof courses, clapboard siding, water ripples
worldUnits: Feet authored locally; root scale .3048 maps to metres
camera: True geometry for clubhouse, roof, rail fence, benches, petal flowers and pond banks; grounded camera-facing detailed foliage sprites support all azimuths and tilt
geometryNotes: Closed extruded triangular terracotta roof body with tile slopes and ridge/eave trim sharing exact endpoints; repeating original grass backdrop continues beneath the compact park at every camera azimuth. Seven separated detailed foliage trees replace eighteen; secondary original bordered CLUBHOUSE plaque sits clear of the roof eave; a grand pixel-lettered PICKLEBALL PARK landmark stands behind the far fence; Portland flag pole is separated from the sign.
runtimeReadiness: Environment ready promise resolves the original foliage TextureLoader; viewer redraws the paused scene once assets are loaded.

parkLayout.clearance: Explicit separated tree placements keep trunks and conservative crown footprints outside pond bank and bench footprints.
parkLayout.underlay: Unpopulated repeating original grass plane beyond the 104 by 108 foot compact park, with a quiet darker perimeter strip. No added remote scenery.
parkLayout.landmark: Original double-sided pixel-lettered 28 by 4.5 foot dark forest sign on timber posts, 8.14 feet overall, 10 feet behind the far fence; rear trees flank the landmark.

portlandFlag.design: City of Portland official flag; Douglas Lynch city insignia
portlandFlag.construction: Editable original Canvas2D redraw from inch-based city specification, visually compared with the public reference diagram. 3:5 proportions, counterchanged four-direction river arms, white central concave star, yellow esquarres with white fimbriations. No third-party runtime flag file.
portlandFlag.presentation: World-oriented subdivided 5 by 3 foot mesh with deterministic rally-clock billow on a 14 foot pole. Cloth is in an independently returned dynamicGroup outside the cached static world. No independent animation loop; repeated time samples do not update geometry.
